scope.retry: One retry only for a bodyless non-writer GET or HEAD when a reused upstream keep-alive socket fails with ECONNRESET before any response
scope.writers: PUT, POST, DELETE, PATCH and atomic account export/import requests remain single-attempt
scope.payload: No request payload, cloud revision, checksum, database row or leaderboard record is modified

verification.deployment: Both production nodes retained the existing API writer PID while only the proxy process was replaced

rollback: Atomically repoint the control symlink to /usr/local/lib/dsp-idle-release/1.0.42-c24e6247d257 and replace only the proxy process; never restore the production database
